verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents a domain pricing page. It says registrations and auto-renewals are charged at member-level rates with no membership or API fees, and register, renew and transfer are each priced through their own quote endpoints. The pack never shows a published per-TLD price list, and nothing confirms renewal prices match first-year prices. missing for 10: a published full price list per TLD, registration/renewal/transfer prices shown side by side, explicit evidence of no teaser first-year pricing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the full price list is published — registration, renewal, and transfer priced separately per TLD, with no teaser first-year price hiding a renewal spike

citations.quote: Registrations and auto-renewals are charged at member-level rates with no membership fee, no API access fee, and no limit on the number of domains you can register at these prices.

Every commercial mutation (register,
renew, transfer) requires a `quoteToken` minted by the corresponding quote
collection endpoint.
